app.title: Show HN: Hamilton – a no-internet Android health dashboard, named after my dog
app.author: hamilton_app
app.description: An offline Android health dashboard app that tracks health metrics without requiring an internet connection.
proposed_tests: Install the app via APK or Google Play and launch it
Add a sample health metric (e.g., steps, heart rate) and verify persistence
Open the app offline and confirm it remains functional
Check that data syncs when connectivity is restored
